# hurl-orchestra

> AI first API automation testing: write each step of an API test as a small text file, and run the steps in the right order.

This file points AI agents and other tools to the documentation of hurl-orchestra.

## Published documentation

- [Short index](https://www.estacouveflor.com/hurl-orchestra/llms.txt): Each page with a summary.
- [Full documentation](https://www.estacouveflor.com/hurl-orchestra/llms-full.txt): All pages in one file.
- [Upgrade guide](https://www.estacouveflor.com/hurl-orchestra/guide/upgrading): Move a suite to 0.13.0 and Hurl 8.1.
- [Hurl compatibility](https://www.estacouveflor.com/hurl-orchestra/reference/hurl-compatibility): Supported versions, reserved options and exit codes.
- [Work with AI agents](https://www.estacouveflor.com/hurl-orchestra/how-to/work-with-ai-agents): Rules for a coding agent.

## Repository documentation

- [README.md](README.md): What the tool does and how to install it.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): How to send a change and how to write the documentation.
- [docs/](docs): The source of the documentation.

## Quick rules

- One scenario in each `.hurl` file.
- Declare each dependency in `deps` and each shared value in `outputs`.
- Use `--dry-run --json` to check the graph before a run. Read `resolved` to see the deps that file mode adds.
- With `--no-deps`, list every dependency file. Without it, hurl-orchestra adds the deps from the same directory.
- Use `--report-ctrf` for CI results.
- Hurl 7.1.0 or later is required. The tests run with 8.1.0.
